alex: @here heads up  we're seeing elevated tail latency for dedicated long-context endpoints in eu-central starting ~09:09 UTC. Error rates low but p95/p99 for requests >16k tokens up ~3x. Customers using pinned-large models may notice slow responses. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1899999999

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-312 created  severity: medium  services: dedicated-inference, serving-runtime  start: 2026-06-10T09:09:59Z

priya: quick triage: latency increase correlated with scheduled quantization conversion rollout for a new 4-bit kernel on the dedicated pool. Conversion jobs kicked off at 09:00 and some shards were served with mixed kernel versions leading to cache miss amplification and slower KV-cache warmups.

dan: mitigation done: 1) paused remaining conversion jobs at 09:15 2) forced uniform kernel selection for affected shards 3) spun up a small hot pool to warm KV caches for long-context workloads. p95 back to ~baseline for most tenants at 09:28.

emily: customer comms: posted dashboard banner at 09:20 UTC and flagged tenants with pinned-large models; CS draft: "We experienced increased latency on long-context hosted dedicated endpoints between 09:09-09:28 UTC due to a conversion rollout. Most requests are back to normal. We'll follow up with postmortem and any customer-specific impact."

priya: remediation followups: 1) audit conversion rollout logic to ensure safe canary across shards 2) add a preflight check for active cache hit ratio before conversion 3) schedule a rollback table if mixed-kernel serving detected.

dan: verification commands used: `kubectl -n dedicated get pods -l pool=eu-central-hot` and `./tools/trace_kvcache.sh --since 09:00 --pool eu-central`  no data corruption observed.

support: affected customers list small (6 tenants) and CS already reached out. No billing credits planned at this time.

incident-bot: Current status: mitigated  monitoring  link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1899999999  postmortem: scheduled 2026-06-11T15:00Z

alex: thanks everyone. Please add any extra notes to the postmortem doc and tag the inference-team. If you see regressions reopen this thread. :rocket:
